entities.name: HBV withdrawal relapse cohort
observations: In a prospective cohort of 113 chronic HBV patients stopping nucleos(t)ide analogues (32 on lamivudine), virological relapse within one year occurred in 57.8% of HBeAg-positive and 54.4% of HBeAg-negative participants overall; neither hepatic decompensation nor HCC occurred during follow-up. This was not specifically a cohort recovered from decompensating flare.
